svg.title: HMIS data platform architecture
svg.desc: DHIS2 is ingested by Prefect into the Silo data lake landing layer as received. dbt transforms it to staging (PII hashed) and intermediate (PII removed) in Silo, then builds gold marts in ClickHouse that Metabase, the dbt docs site and SQL users read.
svg.text: DHIS2 → Prefect → Silo data lake → dbt → ClickHouse → Metabase
received. This step is not dbt.
by data set and date window
Landing, Staging and Intermediate layers · bucket hmis-datalake
Only gold is exposed: no PII reaches users
